name: Santa Monica Proper Hotel
positioning: Kelly Wearstler-designed wellness hotel built around a restored 1920s landmark in Downtown Santa Monica, a short walk from the beach
best_for: Wellness-focused travelers who want an Ayurvedic spa, recovery suites and a 24/7 gym on site
Travelers who want a walkable base near the beach, the Pier and Third Street Promenade
Families who need a suite that sleeps up to six

facts.text: The hotel is at 700 Wilshire Boulevard in Santa Monica, just blocks from the beach, the Pier and Third Street Promenade.
Santa Monica Beach is 0.4 miles away, about an 8-minute walk.
The hotel was designed by interior designer Kelly Wearstler, who blended coastal-modern aesthetics with layered textures.
The hotel combines a restored 1920s landmark building with bold design.
Rooms in the re-imagined landmark building have a Spanish Revival influence.
Bathrooms have walk-in travertine showers, marble vanities and Aesop bath products.
Proper Sleep Rooms pair Eight Sleep sleep technology with Kelly Wearstler design.
The Family Suite sleeps up to six guests in two connected bedrooms.
The fitness center is open 24/7, with complimentary yoga and bootcamp classes, and VO2 Max testing is available to guests.
The hotel provides gear for beach volleyball, Electra bikes for cycling, and beach towels.
Calabra is an indoor-outdoor rooftop restaurant with Pacific Ocean views and Mediterranean-Californian cuisine.
Palma is an art-filled lobby lounge for all-day dining.

highlights.text: The heated rooftop pool looks out over the surf, coastline, mountains and cityscape, with cabanas, private alcoves and a circular bar with a fireplace.
Surya Spa is a collaboration with Ayurvedic doctor, chef and herbalist Martha Soffer; its signature Abhyanga is a four-handed massage with warm herbalized oils cooked overnight.
Two private Recovery Suites, Hyperion and Soma, offer red light, PEMF and compression therapy, cold plunges, a dry sauna and the Ammortal Chamber.
Garden Terrace King rooms, on the second floor, have private walled-in patios with lush plantings.
Guests in the one-, two- and three-bedroom suites can reserve a private alcove at the rooftop pool.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Downtown Santa Monica, about an 8-minute walk from the beach, not on the sand.
The rooftop pool is shared with Proper Club members, and non-guests can use it with day passes, subject to availability.
WhataHotel notes typical city noise levels in the urban setting.
